title: Signal-Routed Temperature Scaling: Low-Capacity Risk-Conditioned Calibration for Small Validation Budgets
abstract: arXiv:2609.38936v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a classifier is recalibrated from only a few thousand held-out examples, the capacity of the calibration map becomes a statistical design choice rather than a purely architectural one: a scalar map can underfit structured residual miscalibration, while a highly adaptive map can be hard to estimate reliably from so small a split. We disentangle the calibration objective from adaptive capacity and propose signal-routed temperature scaling (SRTS-BCE), a 10-parameter, argmax-preserving calibrator that cross-fits a correctness-risk score over six logit statistics and fits one top-label-BCE temperature per $K=3$ risk groups, recovering TvA-TS as its $K=1$ limit. On fine-tuned CIFAR-100 / ViT-B/16, SRTS-BCE reduces $\mathrm{ECE}_{15}$ from 1.65 (scalar TvA-TS) to 0.96, matching the higher-capacity SMART+BCE head (0.95) at the full calibration budget. translated_title: 信号路由温度缩放：面向小验证预算的低容量风险条件校准器
translated_abstract: 当分类器仅用几千个留出样本进行重新校准时，校准映射的容量就成为一种统计设计选择，而不仅仅是架构设计问题：标量映射可能无法拟合结构化的残差失准，而高度自适应的映射在如此小的数据划分下又难以可靠估计。我们将校准目标与自适应容量解耦，提出信号路由温度缩放（SRTS-BCE），这是一种包含10个参数、保持argmax不变的校准器，它通过对六个logit统计量进行交叉拟合得到正确性风险评分，并为K=3个风险组各拟合一个基于top标签BCE的温度，在K=1的极限情况下可退化为TvA-TS。在微调后的CIFAR-100/ViT-B/16上，SRTS-BCE将ECE₁₅从1.65（标量TvA-TS）降至0.96，在全量校准预算下与容量更高的SMART+BCE头部（0.95）相当。随着预算缩小，两种方法的表现出现分化：在n=250时，SRTS-BCE在……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出仅含10个参数、按风险分组设置温度的信号路由温度缩放方法（SRTS-BCE），在小验证预算下实现比标量方法更准、比高容量方法更稳健的分类器校准。
en_tdlr: SRTS-BCE, a 10-parameter, argmax-preserving, risk-conditioned temperature scaling calibrator, achieves more accurate calibration than scalar methods and greater robustness than high-capacity methods under small validation budgets.
